description.value: The Gillnetter Pub is a two-storey neighbourhood pub in Port Coquitlam, situated at the junction of the Mary Hill Bypass and Pitt River Road. It combines a full dine-in and takeout food menu with an attached liquor store carrying domestic and imported wines, specialty beers, and spirits — including VQA wines at below-government-store prices. The pub is adults-only (no minors permitted), making it a local fixture for the surrounding community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Gillnetter Pub is a real, open business at 1864 Argue Street, Port Coquitlam, matching the OSM address exactly. The site explicitly states 'DINE IN AND TAKE OUT MENU' and 'GLUTEN FREE OPTIONS AVAILABLE-PLEASE ASK YOUR SERVER,' providing positive evidence for takeout and GF options respectively. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides (604) 941-5599 — added from website source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub with confirmed dine-in and takeout service; a practical food and drink stop for touring cyclists passing through Port Coquitlam.
